name: husked rice (uncooked)
definition: A grain of rice that has had its outer shell or husk removed, but has not yet been cooked.

name: rice plant
definition: The plant that produces the grain used for food.

name: to be ripe
definition: To reach a state of being fully grown, soft, and ready to be eaten, especially in the case of fruit or grain.

name: river
definition: A large, natural stream of water that flows continuously in a bed towards an ocean, sea, lake, or another river.

name: to roast
definition: To cook food using dry heat, such as over an open fire or in an oven, without using water or oil.

name: root (tree)
definition: The part of a plant that grows underground, branching out from the stem or trunk to absorb water and nutrients from the soil.

name: rope
definition: A strong, thick cord made of twisted fibers or strands used for tying, pulling, or fastening things together.

name: to be rotten
definition: To undergo a process of decay or decomposition, typically used for organic matter like food or wood, making it soft, smelly, or unfit for use.

name: to be rough
definition: To have an uneven, coarse, or bumpy surface rather than being smooth.
burmese: ကြမ်းတမ်းသည်

name: to be round
definition: To have a shape that is circular or spherical, without any corners or straight edges.

name: to rub
definition: To move one's hand or an object repeatedly against a surface using pressure.

name: ruler (chief)
comment: CONCEPTICON has the measuring tool as the definition.
definition: A person who has political power and authority over a group of people or a territory.
burmese: အကြီးအကဲ သို့မဟုတ် အုပ်ချုပ်သူ

name: saliva
definition: The watery liquid produced in the mouth by the salivary glands.

name: salt
definition: A white or translucent mineral used in small amounts to season or preserve food.

name: to scrape (with edge)
definition: To remove a thin layer or surface from an object by rubbing it with a sharp or hard edge.
burmese: ခြစ်ရန် သို့မဟုတ် ခြစ်ရန်

name: to scratch (with nails)
definition: To use one's fingernails to rub or scrape against the skin or a surface.
burmese: မကြေသေးသော ဆန်၊

name: to see
definition: To perceive something through the eyes.

name: seed
definition: The small, hard part of a plant that can be planted in the ground to grow a new plant.

name: to sell
definition: To give an object or service to another person in exchange for money or other goods.

name: to sew
definition: To join or attach pieces of fabric, leather, or other materials together using a needle and thread.

name: shade (area)
definition: An area of ground or space that is kept dark and cool because an object is blocking the light from the sun.

name: shadow (of something)
definition: A dark area or shape produced on a surface by an object that blocks light.
burmese: မကျက်သောဆန်

name: to be sharp (of edge)
definition: To have a thin, fine edge capable of cutting easily.
burmese: အစွန်းတစ်ခု၏ချွန်ထက်

name: to be sharp (of point)
definition: To have a fine, thin, or tapered edge or end that can easily cut or pierce something.
burmese: ထက်မြက်သောအချက်၊

name: shield
definition: A piece of strong material, such as wood or metal, held or carried to protect a person from attacks or blows.

name: to shoot (arrow)
definition: To propel an arrow from a bow using a string.

name: to be short (height)
definition: To have a small distance between the top of the head and the soles of the feet, especially when compared to others.

name: to be short (length)
definition: To have a small distance from one end to the other, rather than being long.
burmese: အတိုအရှည်ဖြစ်ရမည်။

name: to be shy
definition: To feel nervous, timid, or uncomfortable, especially when being around other people or in a social situation.

name: younger sibling
definition: A person who has the same parents as you but was born after you.

name: silver
definition: A precious, shiny, grayish-white metal used for making jewelry or coins.

name: to sing
definition: To produce musical sounds with the voice, often following a melody or rhythm.
burmese: သီချင်းသီဆိုရန်

name: to sink
definition: To move or fall downward below the surface of a liquid.
burmese: နစ်မြုပ်ရန်

name: elder sister
definition: A female sibling who was born before the speaker.

name: to sit
definition: To rest the body on the buttocks or a seat rather than standing or lying down.

name: skin
definition: The outer covering of a human or animal body.

name: sky
definition: The expanse of space above the earth or the ground.

name: to sleep
definition: To be in a state of rest where the eyes are closed and the person is unconscious for a period of time.

name: to be slow
definition: To move or act at a low speed, rather than quickly.
japanese: ゆっくりと, おそい

name: to be small
definition: To have a little size or a short length, rather than being large or long.
burmese: သေးငယ်ဖို့

name: to smell (something)
definition: To perceive an odor or scent through the nose.

name: smoke
definition: The visible gas or vapor produced when a substance burns, often seen coming from a fire or an engine.

name: to smoke
definition: To inhale and exhale the smoke from a burning substance, such as tobacco, through a pipe, cigarette, or similar device.
burmese: ဆေးလိပ်သောက်ရန်

name: to be smooth
definition: To have an even and level surface without any bumps, ridges, or roughness.

name: snail
definition: A small, soft-bodied creature that carries a single, hard, spiraled shell on its back and moves slowly by sliding on a layer of slime.

name: snake
definition: A long, thin reptile that has no legs and moves by sliding its body along the ground.

name: snot (liquid mucus)
definition: The liquid or viscous substance that comes out of the nose.

name: to be soft
definition: To have a texture that is easily compressed or yielding to the touch, rather than being hard or firm.

name: to be sour
definition: To have a sharp, acidic, or tart taste, such as the flavor of a lemon or vinegar.
burmese: အချဉ်ဖြစ်ရန်

name: to sow (crops)
definition: To place seeds or grains into the soil so that they may grow into plants.

name: to speak
definition: To use a language or a set of sounds to communicate thoughts and ideas.
burmese: ပြောရန် သို့မဟုတ် ပြောရန်

name: spear
definition: A long-handled weapon with a sharp, pointed head used for thrusting or throwing.

name: spider
definition: An eight-legged arachnid that often spins a web to catch insects.

name: spiderweb
definition: The silk structure spun by an arachnid to catch prey or move around.
burmese: ပင့်ကူအိမ်ကွန်ယက်

name: to spit
definition: To eject saliva or a small amount of liquid from the mouth by force.

name: to squeeze
definition: To apply pressure to an object between two surfaces, such as fingers or hands, often to extract liquid or to change its shape.

name: to stand (in place)
definition: To be in an upright position on one's feet in a single location.

name: star
definition: A large, luminous ball of gas in space that shines in the night sky.

name: to steal
definition: To take property or an object that belongs to someone else without their permission and without paying for it.

name: stick (tree)
definition: A thin, woody piece of a plant or a tree that has fallen or been broken off.

name: to sting (of bee)
definition: To pierce the skin with a sharp organ to inject venom, specifically as an action performed by an insect like a bee or wasp.

name: stone
definition: A hard, solid, non-living mineral matter found in the ground or on the surface of the earth.

name: to be strong
definition: To possess great physical power or force.

name: sun
definition: The star at the center of the solar system that provides light and heat to the earth during the day.

name: to sweat
definition: To exude moisture from the pores of the skin, typically due to heat, physical exertion, or illness.

name: to be sweet
definition: To have a taste like sugar or honey rather than being salty, sour, or bitter.

name: tail
definition: The posterior part of an animal's body that extends from the spine.

name: to be tall
definition: To have a great vertical distance from the bottom to the top, such as a person or a tree.
burmese: အရပ်မြင့်သည်ဖြစ်စေ၊

name: to tether (goats)
definition: To tie an animal, such as a goat, to a fixed object or a stake in the ground so that it can move around within a limited area but cannot wander away.

name: to be thick (of material)
definition: To have a large distance between opposite surfaces or a large width.

name: to be thin (of material)
definition: To have a very small distance between the two sides or surfaces of an object, such as a piece of cloth or a leaf.

name: thorn
definition: A sharp, pointed part on a plant or stem that can prick or scratch the skin.

name: thread (string)
definition: A very thin, long, flexible strand made of fiber or material used for sewing or binding.

name: thunder
definition: The loud, crashing sound caused by lightning in the sky during a storm.

name: to tie (general)
definition: To fasten or secure two or more things together using a cord, string, or rope.

name: tiger
definition: A large, powerful wild cat with orange fur and dark stripes, often found in forests.

name: today
definition: The current day; the day that is happening now, as opposed to yesterday or tomorrow.

name: toe
definition: The digit on a human or animal foot, located at the end of the foot below the toes.

name: tomorrow
definition: The day after the current day.

name: tongue
definition: The fleshy, movable organ inside the mouth used for tasting, swallowing, and speaking.

name: tooth (general)
definition: A hard, white structure in the mouth used for biting or chewing food.

name: tree
definition: A large, perennial plant with a single woody stem or trunk that branches out into limbs and leaves.

name: branch
definition: A woody part of a tree that grows out from the main trunk or a larger limb.

name: tree bark
definition: The hard, outer covering of the trunk and branches of a woody plant.
burmese: သစ်ပင်အခေါက်

name: turtle (tortoise)
definition: A reptile with a hard shell on its back, often living in water or on land.
burmese: လိပ် သို့မဟုတ် လိပ်

name: to be unripe
definition: To be in a state where a fruit or grain is not yet fully grown, soft, or ready to be eaten.

name: urine
definition: A liquid that is produced in the body and excreted through the bladder.

name: valley
definition: A low area of land situated between hills or mountains, often with a river or stream running through it.

name: village
definition: A small human settlement, typically located in a rural area, consisting of a group of houses and their inhabitants.

name: vine (creeper)
definition: A plant with a long, flexible stem that grows along the ground or climbs up other plants or trees.
burmese: စပျစ်၊ တွား

name: to vomit
definition: To eject the contents of the stomach through the mouth.

name: waist
definition: The part of the human body located between the chest and the hips.

name: to walk
definition: To move forward on foot by taking steps.
burmese: လမ်းလျှောက်ရန်

name: to be warm
definition: To have a temperature that is higher than cold but lower than hot.

name: to bathe
definition: To wash or clean the whole body with water.
burmese: ရေချိုးရန်

name: to wash (general)
definition: To remove dirt, soap, or impurities from an object or a person using water.
burmese: ဆေးကြောရန်

name: to wash clothes
definition: To clean garments or pieces of fabric using water and a cleaning agent.

name: water
definition: The clear, colorless liquid that falls from the sky as rain and is necessary for all living things to drink.

name: to be weak
definition: To lack physical strength or power.

name: to weave (baskets)
definition: To make a container or basket by interlacing strips of wood, bamboo, or other flexible materials.

name: to weave (fabric)
definition: To make cloth or fabric by interlacing threads or fibers on a loom.

name: to weep (cry)
definition: To shed tears from the eyes, often as an expression of sadness, pain, or grief.

name: west
definition: The direction where the sun sets in the evening.

name: wind
definition: The natural movement of air caused by differences in atmospheric pressure.

name: wing
definition: The part of a bird, insect, or bat used for flying, consisting of a limb or membrane attached to the body.

name: to winnow
definition: To blow air through a mixture of grain and husks to separate the edible part from the waste.

name: woman (female human)
definition: An adult female human being.

name: wood
definition: The hard, fibrous material that forms the stem or trunk of a tree or shrub.

name: worm (general)
definition: An elongated, soft-bodied animal that crawls on or through the ground.

name: year
definition: A single period of time that it takes for the earth to orbit around the sun.

name: yesterday
definition: The day before today.
